BiblicalUsage: Yeithôwn is an entry, the entrance of a gate measured in Ezekiel's vision of the temple. From the face of the gate of the entrance to the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God measures His gates, and the entrance to His house is no accident.
